releasedModernReference.scope: Released2.4 Werebear explicitly cannot be interrupted while performing attacks or skills; current licensed bear aurastat4 skill_concentration calculates100. This source gate predates that modern bear-specific change.

established: Complete older player death entry first calls the complete transform-state removal helper. A shifted player removes all declared transform states/lists through the original group/removal callbacks and returns through a forced neutral-mode service before any death penalty,dead-client flag,dead collision or ordinary death event cleanup. Missing trained skill/list does not prevent transform flags being cleared. Human control follows the ordinary death branch.

Interruption gate executes4800 supported contexts for ordinary interruptible used skills across neutral/attack/cast/dead modes,requested gethit/block/death/neutral/attack,used-skill presence,bypass,concentration0/20/100,Concentrate and Uninterruptable. Death/bypass/absent used skill differ from concentration. Concentration resists an action transition while an interruptible skill is active; neutral mode remains permitted.

The older gate reads the Concentration state list and Concentrate/Uninterruptable flags; it does not read the bear stat from a bear list. Porting that older gate unchanged would omit the released modern Werebear guarantee.
declaredServices: Inherited stat allocation/free/formula/conversion services preserve the predecessor scope. Stat detach/free executes the original form/group callbacks but does not implement numeric maximum/current-life recomputation. The life sentinel is deliberately unchanged on the shifted branch; this is a service boundary,not a claim that D2R leaves zero life.

Forced-neutral dispatch,death penalties/client/path/event side effects are ordered recording services. Attacker-specific player-ear/arena branches are guarded unexecuted. Null unit is not a supported gate input because the source dereferences it in the first state query.
remaining: Establish the numeric forced-unshift life floor and complete stat recomputation before implementing survival. This trace proves early death diversion,not a current-executable1life result. Current foreign-class/item-only forms remain unsupported.

Native bear concentration should protect actual pending attack/skill action intervals only; do not turn it into permanent stun/knockback/death immunity or prevent deliberate Stop/movement. Other form hurt/block/movement clocks and actual modern client acceptance remain separate.
